modelspec.data.MaskingPolicy.title: MaskingPolicy
modelspec.data.MaskingPolicy.description: The masked-language-modelling policy; of the selected tokens a fraction is replaced by the vocabulary's mask token, a fraction by a random token and the rest kept, 80/10/10 (epic:bert-from-scratch). The three fractions sum to 1, which ESS does not state here. Draws use the Philox key/counter derivation (DESIGN.md § 2.3) with stream tag 3, the next after the tags 0 to 2 of DESIGN.md § 2.3 (story:bert-mlm-batches adds it there). The values are BERT's (Devlin, Chang, Lee, Toutanova 2018, § 3.1) — selection_rate 0.15, mask_fraction 0.8, random_fraction 0.1, keep_fraction 0.1 (coordinator decision D19, 2026-10-24, `.engineering/waves/bert-1.md`).
